name: Google Calendar
description: Typed Google Calendar events, recurrence instances, calendars, sharing rules, settings, colors and free/busy.

permissions.description: Explicit HTTPS Google Calendar v3 calls with supplied OAuth token. Confirmed writes can create, change, share or delete calendars/events. Alternative secret names require host authorization; no retries, refresh, filesystem or listeners. Event ingress requires explicit administrator profiles, saved secret references and provider/relay setup. Installation never provisions subscriptions or executes trigger code.

definitions.name: Get Calendar (Direct)
definitions.description: Get Calendar
definitions.documentation:
Get Calendar: GET /calendars/{calendarId}. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

definitions.description: Create Secondary Calendar
definitions.documentation:
Create Secondary Calendar: POST /calendars. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation CALENDARS_INSERT. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

definitions.description: Patch Calendar
definitions.documentation:
Patch Calendar: PATCH /calendars/{calendarId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation CALENDARS_PATCH. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

definitions.description: Replace Calendar
definitions.documentation:
Replace Calendar: PUT /calendars/{calendarId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation CALENDARS_UPDATE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

definitions.description: Delete Secondary Calendar
definitions.documentation:
Delete Secondary Calendar: DELETE /calendars/{calendarId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation CALENDARS_DELETE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

definitions.description: List My Calendars
definitions.documentation:
List My Calendars: GET /users/me/calendarList. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. definitions.name: Get My Calendar Entry (Direct)
definitions.description: Get My Calendar Entry
definitions.documentation:
Get My Calendar Entry: GET /users/me/calendarList/{calendarId}. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

definitions.description: Add Existing Calendar To My List
definitions.documentation:
Add Existing Calendar To My List: POST /users/me/calendarList. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation CALENDAR_LIST_INSERT. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

definitions.description: Patch My Calendar Entry
definitions.documentation:
Patch My Calendar Entry: PATCH /users/me/calendarList/{calendarId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation CALENDAR_LIST_PATCH. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

definitions.description: Replace My Calendar Entry
definitions.documentation:
Replace My Calendar Entry: PUT /users/me/calendarList/{calendarId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation CALENDAR_LIST_UPDATE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

definitions.description: Remove Calendar From My List
definitions.documentation:
Remove Calendar From My List: DELETE /users/me/calendarList/{calendarId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation CALENDAR_LIST_DELETE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. definitions.name: List Events (Direct)
definitions.description: List Events
definitions.documentation:
List Events: GET /calendars/{calendarId}/events. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

definitions.documentation:
Get Event: GET /calendars/{calendarId}/events/{eventId}. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. definitions.description: List Recurring Event Instances
definitions.documentation:
List Recurring Event Instances: GET /calendars/{calendarId}/events/{eventId}/instances. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

definitions.documentation:
Create Event: POST /calendars/{calendarId}/events. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation EVENTS_INSERT. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

definitions.description: Import Private Event Copy
definitions.documentation:
Import Private Event Copy: POST /calendars/{calendarId}/events/import. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation EVENTS_IMPORT. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

definitions.name: Patch Event (Direct)
definitions.description: Patch Event
definitions.documentation:
Patch Event: PATCH /calendars/{calendarId}/events/{eventId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation EVENTS_PATCH. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

definitions.description: Replace Event
definitions.documentation:
Replace Event: PUT /calendars/{calendarId}/events/{eventId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation EVENTS_UPDATE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

definitions.description: Cancel Or Delete Event
definitions.documentation:
Cancel Or Delete Event: DELETE /calendars/{calendarId}/events/{eventId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation EVENTS_DELETE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

definitions.description: Move Event To Calendar
definitions.documentation:
Move Event To Calendar: POST /calendars/{calendarId}/events/{eventId}/move. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation EVENTS_MOVE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. definitions.name: List Calendar Access Rules (Direct)
definitions.description: List Calendar Access Rules
definitions.documentation:
List Calendar Access Rules: GET /calendars/{calendarId}/acl. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

definitions.description: Get Calendar Access Rule
definitions.documentation:
Get Calendar Access Rule: GET /calendars/{calendarId}/acl/{ruleId}. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. definitions.documentation:
Create Calendar Access Rule: POST /calendars/{calendarId}/acl. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation ACL_INSERT. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. definitions.description: Patch Calendar Access Rule
definitions.documentation:
Patch Calendar Access Rule: PATCH /calendars/{calendarId}/acl/{ruleId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation ACL_PATCH. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

definitions.description: Replace Calendar Access Rule
definitions.documentation:
Replace Calendar Access Rule: PUT /calendars/{calendarId}/acl/{ruleId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation ACL_UPDATE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

definitions.description: Delete Calendar Access Rule
definitions.documentation:
Delete Calendar Access Rule: DELETE /calendars/{calendarId}/acl/{ruleId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation ACL_DELETE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. definitions.name: List Calendar Settings (Direct)
definitions.description: List Calendar Settings
definitions.documentation:
List Calendar Settings: GET /users/me/settings. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

definitions.name: Get Calendar Setting (Direct)
definitions.description: Get Calendar Setting
definitions.documentation:
Get Calendar Setting: GET /users/me/settings/{settingId}. Exactly one request, retries=0, no redirects or automatic pagination. Fixed Google Calendar v3 HTTPS origin. Externally issued bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; built-in $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. No token issuance, refresh or service-account signing. Appropriate Google OAuth scopes and account/calendar permissions required. Request cap 512 KiB, response cap 1 MiB; 10-second default and 30-second maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; cleanup bounded to 100 ms. List pages default 100, maximum 2500, with explicit pageToken/syncToken continuation. Incremental 410 requires caller-managed full sync. Dates retain all-day exclusive end dates, offsets, IANA timeZone, recurrence lines, recurringEventId and originalStartTime; cancelled tombstones may contain only id/status. sendUpdates is required for notification-capable event mutations; none can impair external synchronization and Google may still send some emails. Import is a private default-event copy without sendUpdates. ACL writes require explicit sendNotifications where supported. Optional ifMatch uses an ETag; 412 is surfaced without retry. PATCH arrays replace whole arrays and null clears nullable fields; PUT replaces the full writable resource. Known fields projected to named contracts; new unknown provider fields omitted. No watchers, webhook receivers, calendar clear, automatic recurrence expansion or background listeners. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/instances https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/import https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/move https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/freebusy/query https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/calendarList https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/settings

definitions.documentation: Event output contract for Google Calendar event.changed. Canonical relay contract onf.business.v1 is documented in the package ingress setup. The relay must verify the original provider, persist/normalize the event and then authenticate its HTTPS POST with a separate ONF header token. The decoder never sees provider headers and does not verify provider signatures. Only selected resource fields are emitted. Filters scopeId/resourceId are exact matches. Deduplication keeps the last 64 scoped event IDs and checkpoints on trigger success before downstream completion. Repeated older deliveries can run again; downstream operations must be idempotent. No subscription, relay or secret is provisioned by installation. Provider setup: Google Calendar notifications carry X-Goog-* headers with an empty body. The relay validates the saved channel token plus channel/resource IDs; ONF cannot turn those headers into a JSON event. Maintain channel expiration and perform events.list incremental synchronization from a durable syncToken; traverse nextPageToken before saving nextSyncToken. HTTP 410 requires an explicit full resync/baseline rather than an invented event history. Ignore sync hints and split actual changed events into event.changed/event.cancelled using status=cancelled. scopeId is calendarId, resourceId is event.id; use event.id plus etag/updated as stable event identity; cancelled tombstones may guarantee only id, so retain a stable cursor-position identity at the relay when version fields are absent.

ingressRequirements.name: Google Calendar verified event relay
ingressRequirements.description: Calendar channel relay with incremental sync. Accepts the canonical onf.business.v1 envelope only; an external provider-aware relay is required.
setupSteps: Install this reviewed package release; no relay or subscription is installed.
Deploy an independently maintained provider-aware relay which implements the exact provider signature, challenge, authorization and replay rules described below.
Google Calendar notifications carry X-Goog-* headers with an empty body. The relay validates the saved channel token plus channel/resource IDs; ONF cannot turn those headers into a JSON event.

Maintain channel expiration and perform events.list incremental synchronization from a durable syncToken; traverse nextPageToken before saving nextSyncToken. HTTP 410 requires an explicit full resync/baseline rather than an invented event history.

Ignore sync hints and split actual changed events into event.changed/event.cancelled using status=cancelled. scopeId is calendarId, resourceId is event.id; use event.id plus etag/updated as stable event identity; cancelled tombstones may guarantee only id, so retain a stable cursor-position identity at the relay when version fields are absent.

Emit canonical JSON {contract:"onf.business.v1",provider:"google-calendar",eventType,eventId,scopeId,resourceId,occurredAt,resource}; occurredAt and nullable resource fields must explicitly be null when unavailable. The resource fields and eventType are defined by the selected trigger schema. Preserve eventId across relay retries.
Save a separate relay-to-ONF callback secret; create a header-authenticated ingress profile for this requirement.
Bind the intended trigger node, configure the relay with its HTTPS callback URL, then deliberately enable workflow and entry.
Review relay limits, delivery identifiers, retries and downstream idempotency; test explicitly before production use.

Select saved node entry mode webhook explicitly; package metadata does not infer it. Create/select a profile for this exact installed requirement (installation.id + "/verified-provider-relay"), bind node.trigger.ingress.profileId, save the graph and deliberately enable workflow and entry only when setup is complete.
